--CREATING DATABASE CREDENTIALS
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM sys.database_credentials WHERE name='synapse_creds')
BEGIN
CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL synapse_creds
WITH
    IDENTITY='Managed Identity'
END;


--CREATING EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM sys.external_data_sources WHERE name='gold_source')
BEGIN
CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE gold_source
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'https://akashsynapselake.dfs.core.windows.net/gold',
    CREDENTIAL = synapse_creds
)
END;

--CREATING EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM sys.external_file_formats WHERE name='delta_format')
BEGIN
CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT delta_format
WITH
(
    FORMAT_TYPE = DELTA
)
END;
